title: Portal Chats: each reply shows who wrote it, and starts where the client wrote
text: Staff messages now show the first name of the team member who sent them (Antonio, Luca or Jodi) instead of "TD Team", in the CRM, in TD Social and in the client's own portal chat. Older messages show the name too. Messages from the shared support login stay "TD Team", and WhatsApp replies are unchanged. In a person's chat, the reply now starts on the company or Personal where the client's latest message was written, instead of always Personal. It follows the client until you pick one yourself, and it never moves while you are typing.
points: Open a chat: staff messages show Antonio, Luca or Jodi
Open a person's chat: "Send as" starts where the client last wrote
Pick a company or Personal yourself: it stays until you open another chat
